printed_facts.fact: The y-axis is labeled 'Temperature (°C)' with major ticks at 0, 5, 10, 15, 20. The scale extends slightly above 20.
The x-axis is labeled 'Year' with ticks for every year from 2005 to 2015.
Each data point has a text label above it indicating the specific temperature value.

Other labeled values include 22.8°C (2006), 21.9°C (2007), 20.3°C (2008), 19.1°C (2009), 16.3°C (2010), 15.4°C (2012), 13.9°C (2013), and 12.2°C (2014). Note: The 2011 tick mark is present on the x-axis but has no corresponding data point or label.
